mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 4.0% reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, increasing present value of future earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.7% in a 3-month window signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.7%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1400) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS < 360000) indicates housing sector contraction that reduces consumer spending and economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are below thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces goods demand and corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth above 2.0% annually indicates economic expansion that increases corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% annually.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls decline exceeding 100,000 in a month signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer income and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS declines by over 100k.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1400 (HOUST < 1400) signals housing market downturn that reduces consumer confidence and economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST is below 1400.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous industrial production decline (INDPRO < 100) and inflation rise (CPIAUCSL > 205) indicates stagflationary pressures that reduce corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is below 100 and CPIAUCSL is above 205.
